# Mediawijs

> Mediawijs guides Belgians through digital literacy, online safety, and digital inclusion with evidence-based resources for educators, parents, and vulnerable populations.

Mediawijs is Belgium's leading platform for media and digital literacy education, offering comprehensive guidance on topics ranging from cyberbullying prevention and online safety to advertising awareness and digital inclusion. The organization serves educators, parents, youth workers, and at-risk populations across Flanders and Brussels.

## Key Topics

- media literacy
- digital inclusion
- digital exclusion
- digital divide
- cyberbullying
- online safety
- digital skills
- child safety online
- parenting in digital world
- advertising literacy
- misinformation
- conspiracy theories
- hate speech
- sexting education
- digital accessibility

## Core Resources & Foundations

- [Mediawijs Homepage](https://www.mediawijs.be/nl): Main entry point for knowledge and inspiration on digital literacy in Belgium
- [Why is Media Literacy Important?](https://www.mediawijs.be/nl/artikels/waarom-mediawijsheid-belangrijk): Foundational article on why media literacy matters for societal participation
- [Why is Digital Inclusion Important?](https://www.mediawijs.be/en/article-overview/why-digital-inclusion-important): Article on digital inclusion importance and avoiding digital exclusion
- [What is the Digital Divide?](https://www.mediawijs.be/nl/artikels/wat-de-digitale-kloof-en-wat-het-verschil-met-digitale-uitsluiting): Article explaining digital divide vs digital exclusion and social inequality

## Online Safety & Cyberbullying

- [Recognizing Cyberbullying: Warning Signs](https://www.mediawijs.be/nl/artikels/cyberpesten-herkennen-op-welke-signalen-kan-je-letten): Guide to recognizing cyberbullying warning signs in youth behavior
- [Consequences of Cyberbullying](https://www.mediawijs.be/nl/artikels/wat-zijn-de-gevolgen-van-cyberpesten): Guide on short and long-term mental health impacts of cyberbullying
- [Hate Speech vs Cyberbullying](https://www.mediawijs.be/nl/artikels/3-verschillen-haatspraak-cyberpesten): Comparative analysis of hate speech and cyberbullying differences
- [Cybersecurity](https://www.mediawijs.be/nl/cybersecurity): Comprehensive dossier on cybercrime prevention and online safety

## Education & Parenting Guides

- [Parenting in a Digital World](https://www.mediawijs.be/nl/dossiers/opvoeden-een-digitale-wereld): Comprehensive dossier on parenting, teaching, and digital world guidance
- [Teaching About Sexting in the Classroom](https://www.mediawijs.be/nl/artikels/hoe-werk-je-rond-sexting-de-klas): Teacher guide on sexting education balancing risk awareness and quality
- [Managing Conspiracy Theory Beliefs in Class](https://www.mediawijs.be/nl/artikels/wat-als-een-leerling-gelooft-een-complottheorie): Teacher guidance on managing conspiracy theory beliefs in classrooms
- [Mediacoach Youth Services Training](https://www.mediawijs.be/nl/mediacoach-jeugdhulp): Professional training program for youth services in media literacy

## Media Literacy & Critical Thinking

- [Advertising Literacy (Reclame?Wijs!)](https://www.mediawijs.be/nl/dossiers/reclamewijs): Dossier on advertising literacy and personalized content recognition
- [Why International News Media Differs](https://www.mediawijs.be/nl/artikels/waarom-zeggen-buitenlandse-nieuwsmedia-soms-iets-anders): Article on international news differences, press freedom, and media bias
- [History of Propaganda](https://www.mediawijs.be/en/article-overview/where-did-propaganda-come): Historical overview of propaganda from Ancient Greece to modern era

## Digital Inclusion & Support

- [Sustainable Digital Mindset (Avansa)](https://www.mediawijs.be/nl/artikels/avansa-wijst-de-weg-naar-een-duurzame-digitale-mindset): Article on sustainable digital mindset development for vulnerable groups
- [What is a Digipunt?](https://www.mediawijs.be/nl/artikels/wat-een-digipunt): Guide to finding and using digipunten for digital support in Flanders

## Optional - Archived Events

- [Networking Event: Videogames and Media Literacy Measurement](https://www.mediawijs.be/nl/kalender/archief/netwerk-en-inspiratiemoment-videogames-en-meten-van-mediawijsheid): Archived networking event on videogames and media literacy measurement
- [Online Conference: Media Literacy Impact Measurement Models](https://www.mediawijs.be/nl/kalender/archief/online-conferentie-modellen-voor-impactmeting-van-mediawijsheid): Archived online conference on media literacy impact measurement models
